name: changes
description: See what Claude changed, turn by turn. Keep it or send it back. A per-turn timeline with each file's diff and keep/revert.

band.title: Band
band.description: After a turn that changed code, a line above the prompt with an [Open] button. Docs, notes and lockfiles never show it.

autoOpen.title: Open by itself
autoOpen.description: Open the pane when the first turn with code changes ends, if the layout docks panes and the terminal is wide.

tellClaude.title: Tell Claude about reverts
tellClaude.description: After a revert, add a hidden note so Claude knows the file changed back.

trackShell.title: Track shell writes
trackShell.description: In a git repository, find files that Bash and PowerShell commands changed, by git status before and after.

keepHistoryDays.title: Keep history (days)
keepHistoryDays.description: How many days the copies of changed files and the history are kept after a conversation was last used, so a resumed conversation can still revert. 0 deletes them at the end of each session.
